## Free MT5 tools
- [Free MT5 Indicators & Forex Tools](https://qaziforextips.com/free-mt5-tools.html): all free tools in one place.
- [QFT Sessions & Killzones – free ICT killzones indicator for MT5 and MT4](https://qaziforextips.com/ict-killzones-indicator-mt5.html): Asia, London and New York sessions in Pakistan (PKT) and India (IST) time, all four ICT killzones, automatic daylight saving, previous day high/low, and liquidity sweep → MSS setups marked with win rate and total R. 100% free download, no DLL.
- [QFT FVG Pro – free FVG (fair value gap) indicator for MT5 and MT4](https://qaziforextips.com/fvg-indicator-mt5.html): fair value gaps with the 50% CE line, dynamic fill, inversion FVG (IFVG), balanced price range (BPR), higher timeframe FVGs, trend and killzone tags, and a unique self-test that compares FVGs with random zones of the same shape. Our test of 23,773 FVGs on XAUUSD and EURUSD (2023–2025, M5/M15): a limit at the 50% CE line beat random zones in 8 of 8 tests (31% vs 28% win rate at 1:2), while "touch and bounce" was no better than random. 100% free download, no DLL.
- [QFT Trading Coach, Journal & Report – free trading journal for MT5](https://qaziforextips.com/free-trading-journal-mt5.html): reads the MT5 trade history automatically (nothing to type), finds 9 trading mistakes (revenge trade, bigger lot after a loss, no stop loss, risking over 2%, trading after the daily loss limit, overtrading, holding losers, closing winners early, trading near high-impact news), shows the money each mistake cost, grades every trade A+ to F on process, builds a weekly coach plan, sessions/symbols/exit statistics, prop firm check and Monte Carlo, and saves reports in English and Roman Urdu. 100% free; data stays on the trader's PC.
- [Lot Size Calculator for Forex & Gold](https://qaziforextips.com/lot-size-calculator.html): free online lot size calculator.
- [QFT Replay Simulator](https://qaziforextips.com/simulator.html): market replay and manual backtesting inside MT5 and MT4 (free demo); version 3.05 backtests up to 4 pairs at once (SMT, DXY, correlation). A Soft4FX / FX Replay alternative.
- [QFT Trade Assistant](https://qaziforextips.com/trade-assistant.html): risk-based lot size and trade panel for MT5 and MT4 (free demo).
- [Licence & Refund Policy](https://qaziforextips.com/licence-policy.html): free demo first; 1 licence per MT5/MT4 account; free account move up to 2 times in 12 months; refund within 7 days if a technical problem cannot be fixed; prices on each tool page.

## Research
- [Do fair value gaps work? We tested 23,773 FVGs](https://qaziforextips.com/research-do-fair-value-gaps-work.html): QFT Research report 1. 23,773 fair value gaps on XAUUSD and EURUSD (2023–2025) compared with random zones of the same size: a limit at the 50% CE line beat random zones in 8 of 8 M5/M15 tests (31% vs 28% at 1:2), a plain touch-and-bounce did not (42% vs 41%), trend and killzone filters did not help, and the CE trade alone was about −0.07R before costs. Method, limitations and a CSV summary included.
